title: still present since round 3: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts that contradict the seeded awaiting list
detail: Bulk-invite ignores the typed emails and returns a canned 'bad@example.ie'; reminders return hardcoded counts and discard the store. The demo teaches an outcome that never happened.
recommended_fix: Parse the submitted emails, compute the result from actual input, and thread the mutated store (or drop the fake mutation).

title: still present since round 3: Vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally - nonexistent ids report success; the Result error channel is dead
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1245 (archive_vacancy), :1259 (restore_vacancy), :1273 (close_vacancy): '#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))'; demo_store.gleam:1345 (change_status): '#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))'
detail: The list.map no-ops when no id matches yet Ok is returned; callers cannot distinguish a miss from a mutation. Four mutation fns share the shape.
recommended_fix: Check the match after the map and return Error on miss, or drop the Result and simplify the call chain.

title: still present since round 3: mark_opened doc claims an idempotent Submitted->UnderReview transition but applies it to any status
detail: The store-side transition has no status guard; change_status overwrites whatever status the application has. Idempotency rests entirely on the dispatch-layer open_dispatched set.
recommended_fix: Transition only when the current status is Submitted; otherwise leave the store unchanged.

title: still present since round 3: create_vacancy derives the id from an 8-char-truncated name slug with no uniqueness check
detail: Two demo-created vacancies whose property names share an 8-char cleaned prefix get the same id; the second silently shadows the first in store lookups.
recommended_fix: Append a disambiguator (sequence or count) or extend the suffix until unique.

title: still present since round 3: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
detail: Latent today (load-more hidden in demo) but the parameter is discarded; the full leaderboard returns for every page.
recommended_fix: Slice by page or drop the parameter.

title: still present since round 3: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention - ids can collide and one timeout dismisses both
evidence: demo_update.gleam:638: 'let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1' ... 'next_toast_id: toast_id'; client.gleam add_toast:7115 uses 'let id = model.next_toast_id' then 'next_toast_id: id + 1'
detail: The demo toast helper allocates ids outside add_toast's scheme and skips the 5-toast cap; divergent conventions can collide ids.
recommended_fix: Reuse add_toast's id allocation (or call add_toast with ToastInfo).

title: still present since round 3 (store_of half fixed): download_timeout still duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam with divergent signatures
detail: The store_of duplicate was deduplicated (client.gleam:5919 delegates), but the two download_timeout variants persist and still diverge in signature.
recommended_fix: Lift download_timeout to the shared demo helper module with one signature.

title: still present since round 3: zero-caller export demo_store.notifications shipped
detail: Export with no callers; dead surface in the demo store.

title: still present since round 3: status_from_slug silently coerces any unknown status slug to Submitted
detail: Typos in demo action wires silently land as Submitted rather than failing loudly.
recommended_fix: Return a Result or panic on unknown slugs in the demo store.
